description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - The Consular Functions Act, No. 4 of 1981 this Notification Specify with effect from 01.01.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Consular Functions Act, No. 4 of 1981 and specifies new fees for consular services. It constitutes a regulatory framework amendment that modifies existing fee structures and rescinds previous notifications. The content focuses entirely on legal/regulatory matters - establishing new fees, specifying procedures, and modifying existing regulations - without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or falling into other specialized categories like land, commercial, or public service matters.
